language.label: Display language
language.help: Applies right away. Translations are in progress: text not yet translated stays in French. The language also sets how numbers and dates are displayed; the saved workbook does not depend on it.

htmlTabs.label: Web pages
htmlTabs.help: Lets you add web pages: an HTML, CSS and JavaScript page that reads and changes the workbook, or a page from a website. Workbooks that already contain some open and work normally.

sharedWorkbooks.label: Shared workbooks (Lattis Server)
sharedWorkbooks.help: Lets you sign in to your organization's Lattis Server (Account menu in the title bar) and add it as a data source. Shared workbooks live there; you sign in with your account (Google, Microsoft, Keycloak…) or a Lattis password.

coEditing.label: Work together on a shared folder
coEditing.help: A workbook stored on a NAS or a network share and already open on another computer offers “Work together”: everyone edits the table data and sees the others' changes live (one log per computer next to the file). When turned off, it opens read-only or “anyway”, as before.

aiEnabled.label: AI assistant
aiEnabled.help: The “Assistant ✦” button, at the top right of the ribbon (Alt+I), opens a pane to the right of the grid: an assistant that helps build an analysis and acts on the workbook, each answer undone in one step. It needs an API key from a provider (Anthropic, Mistral, OpenAI…), kept in the system keychain, a model installed on this computer, or Claude Desktop with a Claude subscription.

aiDataSharing.label: Data sent to the assistant
aiDataSharing.schemaOnly: Structure only (names, types, number of rows and distinct values)
aiDataSharing.sample: Structure and a few sample rows (20 at most per read)
aiDataSharing.full: The whole workbook (the assistant can read every value)
aiDataSharing.help: Also applies to Claude Desktop and Claude Code through the MCP server. The provider also receives your messages, the active sheet and the selection; with a local model, nothing leaves this computer.

aiKeepConversation.label: Keep the conversation in the workbook
aiKeepConversation.help: The conversation is saved with the workbook and comes back the next time it opens: it travels with the file, including the query results shown and the rows read by the assistant. It is only saved if the workbook was also changed. Otherwise, it is cleared when you close the workbook or open another one.

aiLocalUrl.label: Local model address
aiLocalUrl.help: “Local model” provider: the address of Ollama, LM Studio or another OpenAI-compatible server on this computer. No data leaves the computer.

theme.label: Default color theme
theme.help: Colors of regular tables and of tables from an external source in a workbook that has not chosen its theme: new workbooks and those from before themes. The theme chosen in a workbook (View › Theme) is saved with it and looks the same on other computers.

undoDepth.label: Undo depth
undoDepth.help: Number of commands Ctrl+Z can undo (200 by default). The history is never saved in the file.

scriptSeconds.label: Maximum script duration
scriptSeconds.help: Beyond this, the script is stopped and its changes are undone (30 s by default).

sqlReadSeconds.label: Maximum SQL read duration
sqlReadSeconds.help: Queries in the SQL tab and reads from scripts (30 s by default).

sqlWriteSeconds.label: Maximum SQL write duration
sqlWriteSeconds.help: A write from the SQL tab blocks data entry while it runs; beyond this, it is canceled without changing anything (120 s by default).
